messages:
maya: Hey all — planning to cut release/1.10 tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Quick sync on backports, changelog nudges, and branch creation? :wave:
simon: SGTM. I can freeze non-critical PRs at 09:30 PT and help triage any last-minute cherrypicks :+1:
eli: Quick question: what's our preferred workflow for backports this time — open PRs against main and cherrypick, or open directly against release/*?
maya: prefer main-first, then cherrypick. Keeps history clean. If you need to target release/* directly, ping me with the reason.
maya: Steps I'll run when window closes (copyable):
```
# from repo root
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.10 origin/main
# update version & changelog locally
git commit -am "chore: release/1.10 prep"
git push origin release/1.10
```
simon: can the cherrypick bot handle PRs labeled `backport/1.10`?
eli: yes — label + comment `/cherry-pick` triggers the bot. If bot fails, manual cherrypick to release branch and mark with `cherry-picked-by` note.
anika: QA will run smoke on release/1.10 after branch is pushed. Please tag @qa-team in PRs needing verification.
tj: Reminder to bump package versions and add one-line changelog entries (imperative tense). Example: `fix(api): avoid double-schedule on retry`. Keep entries short for the autogenerated release notes. :memo: 
maya: Backport rules reminder (short): only bugfixes, regressions, critical perf fixes, and security patches. No UX features or larger refactors unless pre-approved. Always add a short justification in the PR body.
eli: Also add `cherry-pick: required` in PR description if it's critical — helps triage.
devops-bot: branch release/1.10 created at commit abc1234 by maya (automated) :robot_face:
manual note: after branch create I'll run the release pipeline and snapshot artifacts.
simon: I'll queue the release cut checklist items and ping infra for capacity checks.
anika: QA will start staging tests at 10:15 PT. If any blocking issues, we'll open hotfix PRs and follow the backport flow.
maya: Great — I'll create branch ~10:05 PT right after merge window closes. Ping here if you need an exception. :shipit:
eli: thanks — I'll open backport PRs for two small fixes shortly.
tj: will post a changelog nudge in docs channel once we have the final PR list.
maya: thanks everyone — will update this thread with the actual branch URL and release notes snippet once live.
